name: Drowned Reeve
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.description: While the drowned reeve is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the drowned reeve's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

abilities.name: Umbral Step (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the drowned reeve takes the Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drowned reeve makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Grave-Cold Bolt.

actions.name: Strike Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grave-Cold Bolt
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failed save.

generation.userConcept: a reeve of the drowned marsh who never loses a trail

clauses.text: a reeve of the drowned marsh

generation.cite: composition after Assassin (CR 8) — the rider-heavy burst and the expertise Stealth
